title: Classic Omelette
description: A quick fluffy omelette with cheese and herbs.

steps.text: Crack 3 eggs into a bowl, add milk, salt, and pepper.
Beat the eggs with a fork until fully mixed (about 30 seconds).
Heat a non-stick pan on medium heat and add butter.
Pour the egg mixture into the pan. Let it cook without stirring for 1 minute.
Gently push the edges inward with a spatula, tilting the pan to let raw egg flow to the edges.
Sprinkle cheese on one half. Fold the other half over. Cook 30 more seconds.
Slide onto a plate. Garnish with fresh herbs if desired. Enjoy!

title: Pasta Aglio e Olio
description: Simple Italian pasta with garlic, olive oil, and chili flakes.

steps.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Add spaghetti and cook until al dente (about 8 minutes). Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water before draining.
While pasta cooks, heat olive oil in a large pan over medium-low heat.
Add sliced garlic to the oil. Sauté gently for 2 minutes until golden (not brown!).
Add chili flakes to the garlic oil. Stir for 15 seconds.
Add the drained pasta to the pan. Toss well with the garlic oil.
Add a splash of reserved pasta water to make it glossy. Toss again.
Serve with chopped parsley and Parmesan on top. Buon appetito!

title: Chicken Karahi
description: A fragrant Pakistani stir-fried chicken with tomatoes and spices.

steps.text: Heat oil or ghee in a karahi (wok) over high heat.
Add cumin seeds and let them splutter for 10 seconds.
Add ginger-garlic paste. Stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add chicken pieces. Cook on high heat for 5 minutes, stirring often.
Add chopped tomatoes, red chili powder, turmeric, and salt. Mix well.
Cover and cook on medium heat for 12 minutes until chicken is tender and tomatoes form a thick sauce.
Remove lid. Add garam masala and green chilies. Stir-fry for 2 minutes on high heat.
Garnish with fresh coriander. Serve hot with naan or rice!
